title: Geologic interpretation of geophysical maps, central Savannah River area, South Carolina and Georgia
citation: Daniels, D.L., 1974, Geologic interpretation of geophysical maps, central Savannah River area, South Carolina and Georgia: U.S. Geological Survey Geophysical Investigations Map GP-893, map scale 1:250,000.
notes: USGS GP-893 (Daniels, 1974): geologic interpretation of 1958 aeromagnetic and aeroradioactivity surveys, central Savannah River area. Map A and sheet 3 units are interpretive (from geophysics plus geology); Emory and Batesburg quadrangle units from reconnaissance mapping. Table 3 basement wells: Georgia rows (1-5, 8, 21) left out; basement altitudes recorded as surfaces with datum not stated. Georgia-only features (Bel Air belt, Appling pluton, A13 breccia) left out. Feature 16/17 lineaments, seismic station velocities and magnetic susceptibility/gamma values are not itemized (locations only on plates, not legible). SUBSURFACE: basement surface points from table 3; Triassic(?) basin boundary faults.
